name: kde-wayland-suite
description: Comprehensive KDE Plasma 6 Wayland configuration plugin for keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C ABNT2 fix), cedilla on US-intl (Chrome, Orca IDE, Electron, GTK, Qt via LC_CTYPE, XCompose & Wayland IME flags), 3/4-finger touchpad gestures, and Logitech MX Master 3S button/scroll configuration via logiops.
